intro.en: Eighteen original short tasks. Write the complete corrected sentence before opening the answer. Compare the meaning and the stated context; acceptable variants are shown where relevant. This is self-review, not an official test score.
intro.ru: 18 авторских коротких заданий. До открытия ответа напиши полное исправленное предложение. Сопоставь смысл и условия; допустимые варианты указаны там, где они есть. Это самопроверка, а не официальный результат теста.

tasks.prompt: Ask about the subject of “Mara lives next door”. Begin with Who.

reason.en: Who replaces the subject, so ordinary positive subject questions do not need do/does. Lives keeps its third-person singular form. This differs from “Where does Mara live?”
reason.ru: Who заменяет подлежащее, поэтому обычный утвердительный вопрос к подлежащему не требует do/does. У lives сохраняется форма третьего лица. В вопросе к месту было бы «Where does Mara live?»

tasks.prompt: Use the present continuous of write: “Please wait. Mara ___ the final sentence right now.”
tasks.answer: Please wait. Mara is writing the final sentence right now.

reason.en: Is + writing presents the activity as in progress now. The instruction requests the continuous form; “Mara writes” would describe a different perspective.
reason.ru: Is + writing показывает действие в процессе сейчас. Условие требует Present continuous; Mara writes передавало бы другой взгляд на ситуацию.

tasks.prompt: Use the past simple of finish: “We ___ the first draft yesterday.”
tasks.answer: We finished the first draft yesterday.

reason.en: Yesterday places the completed event in a finished past period. In this context the requested form is finished, not have finished.
reason.ru: Yesterday относит завершённое событие к закончившемуся прошлому периоду. Здесь нужна запрошенная форма finished, а не have finished.

tasks.prompt: Use the past continuous of read for the background action: “Mara ___ her notes when the bell rang.”
tasks.answer: Mara was reading her notes when the bell rang.

reason.en: Was reading gives the ongoing background; rang is the shorter event that occurs during it. Past simple read is possible in another narrative, but would not express the requested ongoing background.
reason.ru: Was reading задаёт процесс, на фоне которого прозвенел звонок — rang. В другом рассказе возможен Past simple read, но он не передаст требуемый продолжающийся фон.

tasks.prompt: Use the present perfect of know for a continuing state: “I ___ Ben since primary school, and we are still friends.”
tasks.answer: I have known Ben since primary school, and we are still friends.

reason.en: Have known links a state beginning in the past with the present. Know is normally stative here, so have been knowing is not the ordinary choice.
reason.ru: Have known связывает начавшееся в прошлом состояние с настоящим. Know здесь обычно обозначает состояние, поэтому have been knowing не является обычным вариантом.

variants.en: I’ve known Ben since primary school, and we are still friends.
variants.ru: Сокращение I’ve допустимо и сохраняет тот же смысл.

tasks.prompt: Express an intention already decided, using going to: “I ___ rewrite the ending tonight.”
tasks.answer: I am going to rewrite the ending tonight.

reason.en: Am going to + infinitive expresses the requested prior intention. Will and a present continuous arrangement can be grammatical in suitable contexts, but the task explicitly requests going to.
reason.ru: Am going to + инфинитив передаёт заранее принятое намерение. Will и Present continuous возможны в подходящем контексте, но здесь прямо требуется going to.

variants.en: I’m going to rewrite the ending tonight.

tasks.prompt: Repair the comma splice without changing the words: “The corridor was empty, Mara waited by the door.”
tasks.answer: The corridor was empty. Mara waited by the door.

reason.en: Both clauses can stand alone. A comma alone does not normally join them in formal prose; a full stop or semicolon repairs the boundary.
reason.ru: Обе части самостоятельны. В обычной формальной прозе одной запятой между ними недостаточно; границу исправляет точка или точка с запятой.

variants.en: The corridor was empty; Mara waited by the door.
variants.ru: Точка с запятой связывает близкие по смыслу самостоятельные части.

tasks.prompt: Link the two related independent clauses with a semicolon: “Mara checked the switch Ben checked the door.”
tasks.answer: Mara checked the switch; Ben checked the door.

reason.en: Each side has a subject and finite verb and can be a complete sentence. The semicolon links the two checks without adding a conjunction.
reason.ru: В каждой части есть подлежащее и личная форма глагола; обе могут быть предложениями. Точка с запятой связывает две проверки без союза.

tasks.prompt: Insert a colon to introduce the list: “We need three things time patience and a plan.” Add the list punctuation.
tasks.answer: We need three things: time, patience and a plan.

reason.en: The complete clause “We need three things” introduces the list. The colon does not split a verb directly from its object. A serial comma is optional here.
reason.ru: Полная часть We need three things вводит перечень. Двоеточие не разрывает глагол и его дополнение. Запятая перед последним and здесь необязательна.

variants.en: We need three things: time, patience, and a plan.
variants.ru: Вариант с серийной запятой также верен.

tasks.prompt: Three students share one notebook. Add the missing possessive apostrophe: “The students notebook lay on the desk.”
tasks.answer: The students’ notebook lay on the desk.

reason.en: The plural noun students already ends in s, so its possessive adds an apostrophe after s. Student’s would mean one student in this context.
reason.ru: Множественное students уже оканчивается на s; апостроф принадлежности ставится после s. Student’s здесь означало бы одного ученика.

variants.en: The students' notebook lay on the desk.

tasks.prompt: Mark the parenthetical phrase “not the audience” with a pair of dashes: “Mara not the audience knows what the machine can do.”
tasks.answer: Mara—not the audience—knows what the machine can do.

reason.en: The paired dashes set off the interruption. Removing it leaves the complete sentence “Mara knows what the machine can do.” Consistent spaced en dashes are another style.
reason.ru: Парные тире выделяют вставку. Без неё остаётся полное предложение Mara knows what the machine can do. Другой допустимый стиль — одинаковые короткие тире с пробелами.

variants.en: Mara – not the audience – knows what the machine can do.
variants.ru: Допустимы парные en dash с пробелами при последовательном оформлении.

tasks.prompt: Choose your or you’re in both gaps: “___ a careful reader; check ___ evidence.”
tasks.answer: You’re a careful reader; check your evidence.

reason.en: You’re expands to you are, even before the noun phrase “a careful reader”. Your determines evidence and expresses belonging or association.
reason.ru: You’re раскрывается как you are, даже перед именной группой a careful reader. Your относится к evidence и выражает принадлежность или связь.

variants.en: You're a careful reader; check your evidence.

tasks.prompt: Choose its or it’s in both gaps: “___ a new machine, but ___ switch is old.”
tasks.answer: It’s a new machine, but its switch is old.

reason.en: It’s means it is here. Its is the possessive determiner before switch. Elsewhere it’s can also mean it has, as in “It’s been tested”.
reason.ru: Здесь it’s означает it is. Its — форма принадлежности перед switch. В другом контексте it’s может означать it has: It’s been tested.

variants.en: It's a new machine, but its switch is old.

tasks.prompt: Choose there, their or they’re: “___ waiting over ___ with ___ notebooks.”
tasks.answer: They’re waiting over there with their notebooks.

reason.en: They’re = they are; there points to a place; their determines notebooks. Each form has a different grammatical job.
reason.ru: They’re = they are; there указывает место; their относится к notebooks. Каждая форма выполняет свою грамматическую работу.

variants.en: They're waiting over there with their notebooks.

tasks.prompt: Use formal written English: “There were ___ errors, so I spent ___ time editing.” Choose less or fewer.
tasks.answer: There were fewer errors, so I spent less time editing.

reason.en: Errors is a plural countable noun, so fewer fits. Time here is an uncountable duration, so less fits. Measured quantities such as “less than ten minutes” can also take less.
reason.ru: Errors — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе: fewer. Time здесь — неисчисляемая длительность: less. Для единой измеряемой величины также возможно less than ten minutes.

tasks.prompt: Choose affect or effect in the common meanings influence/result: “The noise may ___ the audience; its ___ could be unsettling.”
tasks.answer: The noise may affect the audience; its effect could be unsettling.

reason.en: Affect is the verb influence here, and effect is the noun result. This is a meaning test, not a claim that effect can never be a verb: “effect change” means bring change about.
reason.ru: Здесь affect — глагол «влиять», а effect — существительное «результат, воздействие». Проверяем смысл, а не утверждаем, что effect никогда не бывает глаголом: effect change означает «осуществить перемены».

tasks.prompt: Choose than or then: “Read the scene first, ___ explain why the ending is quieter ___ the opening.”
tasks.answer: Read the scene first, then explain why the ending is quieter than the opening.

reason.en: Then introduces the next step; than follows the comparative quieter. The comma is followed by a coordinated instruction, not two unrelated finite statements.
reason.ru: Then вводит следующий шаг; than следует за сравнительной формой quieter. Запятая связывает последовательные указания с общим подразумеваемым подлежащим you.

tasks.prompt: Choose is or are: “The list of camera locations ___ on the noticeboard.”
tasks.answer: The list of camera locations is on the noticeboard.

reason.en: The subject’s head noun is singular list. The plural noun locations belongs to the of-phrase and does not control this verb.
reason.ru: Главное слово подлежащего — единственное list. Множественное locations входит в оборот с of и здесь не определяет форму сказуемого.
